name: cyrusbadde/wopcart-platform
description: The wopcart.com server side of WopCart: plan verification, Stripe Connect onboarding, the payment proxy and the event relay.

scripts.lint: @php -r "foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator('.')) as $f) { if ($f->getExtension() === 'php' && !str_contains($f->getPathname(), '/vendor/')) { exec('php -l ' . escapeshellarg($f->getPathname()), $o, $c); if ($c !== 0) { echo implode(PHP_EOL, $o), PHP_EOL; exit(1); } } } echo 'OK', PHP_EOL;"

_comment: Composer is a development convenience only. The plugin ships with its own PSR-4 autoloader in src/Autoloader.php and has no runtime dependencies beyond the core WopCart plugin. Without a vendor/ directory of its own, run the core plugin's: ../digital-cart/vendor/bin/phpunit and ../digital-cart/vendor/bin/phpcs.
